# ChipLab - full specification
# Local-first ITCH-50 silicon lab: RTL + WebAssembly + WebGPU + MCP + EXE + Docker + Vercel
# Version: 0.3.1 "Local Cloud"; state as of 2026-11-10

## 1. What it is
ChipLab is a pre-silicon lab around a NASDAQ TotalView-ITCH 5.0 parser. The RTL
(`rtl/`) is the hardware specification; the Rust/WASM core (`wasm-core/`) is the
executable twin used by the browser, Node, MCP, npm, PyPI and the single EXE.

## 2. RTL
- Parser top: `ultra_low_latency_nasdaq_itch50_cutthrough` (DATA_WIDTH 32/128/256/512;
  128 default, 32 verified).
- `itch_shifter.sv`: tkeep-aware, cleared append window, 512-bit sliding window.
- `itch_parser_core.sv`: all 22 official opcodes, full 512-bit payload, 64-bit shares.
- `itch_top.sv`: tkeep/tlast, registered egress, async bypass, counters.
- `itch_top_book.sv` + `itch_top_of_book.sv`: parser + per-locate book, 16 locates,
  16 levels/side, 256 orders, top-4 depth, last trade/volume, risk checks.
- `itch_metrics.sv`: msg/byte/gap/drop/cycle counters, max occupancy, 8-bin gap histogram.
- `itch_host_wrap.sv`: narrow 32-bit host register file; `itch_wishbone_wrap.sv`:
  classic Wishbone slave; `itch_caravel_wrap.sv` + `caravel/user_project_wrapper.v`:
  Caravel-shaped boundary (io_in stream + Wishbone).
- `itch_book_snapshot.sv` + `itch_book_snapshot_top.sv`: per-locate snapshot table with
  a one-cycle read port (top-of-book, last, volume, top-4 depth).
- Mold: `moldudp64_frontend.sv`, `moldudp64_depacketizer.sv`, `moldudp64_pipeline.sv`
  (multi-frame, downstream back-pressure), `mold_feed_arbiter.sv` (A/B selection +
  retransmit request/replay/timeout), `mold_recovery.sv`, `mold_ab_system.sv`,
  `axis_skid_buffer.sv`.

Latency (honest):
- s_axis_tdata -> window register: 1 clock.
- window -> registered output: 1 clock.
- wire-to-registered-output: 2 clocks (6.20 ns at 322.26 MHz model clock).
- async bypass: same cycle as the window, not zero from the wire.

## 3. Protocol coverage
S 12, R 39, H 25, Y 20, L 26, V 35, W 12, K 28, J 35, h 21, A 36, F 40, E 31,
C 36, X 23, D 19, U 35, P 44, Q 40, B 19, I 50, N 20 bytes.

## 4. Verification
- `tb/itch_model.py`: independent reference, 80-byte canonical record.
- `tb/sim_main.cpp`: full-field Verilator regression — 1,000,000 records, 0 mismatches,
  31,383,973 bytes, 1,961,516 cycles, 41.290 Gbps model.
- Nightly default: 10,000,000 records, 0 mismatches (3m06s simulation); `.github/workflows/nightly.yml`.
- Cocotb: 19 suites / 26 tests — parser, Mold, pipeline, multi-frame, book, book+snapshot,
  arbiter (selection/recovery/multi-gap), A/B system, recovery, skid, metrics,
  host/wishbone/Caravel wrappers, 128/32-bit ingress, burst.
- Formal: pre-trigger gating, class exclusivity, legal lengths, register equivalence,
  flow control; Z3 PASS, CVC5 PASS in the matrix.
- Mutation: 9/9 parser→BBO mutants killed (`tools/mutate_book.py`).
- RTL↔WASM equivalence: 100,000 records, every field equal (weekly job).
- Gate: 11 fast checks, 13 with `--deep` (adds Z3 formal + native bins).
- Yosys cells: 22,629 (128), 25,201 (256), 29,628 (512); book 62,017 cells at 32/4/4.

## 5. Web/WASM
- `web/worker.js` owns the WASM memory; `web/core.js` decodes records.
- `web/gpu.js`: WebGPU compute bins + render; Canvas2D fallback.
- `web/app.js`: responsive dense-tool UI, Worker, OPFS history, PWA.
- 1M messages in 664 ms wall on the test host, 0 errors.

## 6. Backend/MCP/API
- `backend/server.mjs`: `/api/health`, `/api/chips`, `/api/run`, `/api/compare`, `/api/book`,
  `/api/cloud/info`, `/api/store[/:namespace]`.
- Local cloud: atomic JSON store under `.data/`, 1 MB cap, revision conflicts, optional
  bearer token; loopback-only writes without a token. Flags: `--host --port --token --data-dir`.
- `backend/run.mjs`: CLI.
- `mcp/server.mjs` (12 read-only tools): `chiplab.chips`, `chiplab.run`, `chiplab.compare`,
  `chiplab.book`, `chiplab.formal_status`, `chiplab.health`, `chiplab.cloud_info`,
  `chiplab.history`, `chiplab.release_status`, `chiplab.sbom`, `chiplab.synth_status`,
  `chiplab.docs` (fixed 13-key catalog).
- `api/*.mjs`: Vercel serverless wrappers; static-first, user data stays in the browser.

## 6b. Release (v0.3.1)
- One version across npm, Cargo, PyPI, MCP, SBOM and the Vercel health endpoint.
- `Release` workflow on tag `v*`: verify -> EXE -> npm/PyPI packages -> SBOM ->
  `SHA256SUMS.txt` -> keyless cosign blob signatures -> GitHub Release (six assets plus
  `*.sigstore.json` bundles).
- Registry publishing is opt-in (`NPM_PUBLISH`/`PYPI_PUBLISH` repository variables) and
  has not been run (needs trusted-publisher/OIDC setup).
- `scripts/release_check.mjs` gates version/changelog/artifacts; `scripts/checksums.mjs`
  writes the manifest.

## 7. Distribution
- `npm run build:exe` -> `dist/chiplab.exe` (Node SEA, embedded web + WASM + local cloud).
- `Dockerfile` -> non-root Node 22 alpine, healthcheck; set `CHIPLAB_TOKEN` for writes.
- `vercel.json` + `scripts/build_vercel.mjs` -> `public/` + `api/`.
- npm `@chiplab/core`; PyPI `chiplab-itch`.
- Native `chiplab-native` (wgpu Vulkan/DX12, `--probe`, `--boost`).

## 8. Physical evidence (Sky130 unless noted, pre-PnR for the parser)
- Parser pre-PnR STA: WNS -9.14 ns at 3.10 ns (~81.5 MHz), -8.27 ns at 4.00 ns (ss).
- 128-bit wrapper: -8.62 ns (~85.3 MHz); 32-bit wrapper: -6.55 ns (~103.7 MHz).
- GF180: -19.87 ns (~43.5 MHz); IHP SG13G2: -3.08 ns (~161.9 MHz), small hold violation.
- Full flow, `itch_metrics` at 10 ns: 0 routing/Magic/KLayout DRC, 0 LVS errors, timing
  closed (WNS +0.12 ns, Fmax ~101 MHz), 6,776 cells, 42,127 um2 on a 500 um die.
- Parser full P&R is blocked: GRT-0116 congestion, GPL-0305 divergence, DPL-0036 pin
  density, GRT-0183 diode insertion, container restarts. No parser sign-off exists.
  See `openlane/README.md` and `docs/long-runs.md`.

## 9. Reproducibility and supply chain
- WASM: rustc pinned 1.98.1; two clean builds and the shipped binary are identical.
- Python: wheel reproducible with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH; sdist after container normalization.
- EXE: two SEA builds byte-identical (same Node 22 toolchain).
- Weekly `Repro` workflow checks all three on Linux and Windows.
- SLSA build provenance for EXE/npm/wheel; Docker `provenance: mode=max` + SBOM + keyless
  cosign signature; npm/PyPI `*.sigstore.json` blob signatures.

## 10. Honest limits
- No fabricated silicon, no tapeout, no bitstream.
- No parser P&R/DRC/LVS result; pre-PnR STA is not a sign-off.
- No 100G MAC, PCIe/DMA or FPGA target integration.
- No full Caravel harness run (the drop-in wrapper and Wishbone path are tested).
- npm/PyPI registry publishing has not been executed.
